purpose: Requirements for which Markdown files become index targets and for issuing, validating and resolving document IDs (DLIDs), including ToC keys, target specification and frontmatter placement.
summary: ToC identification keys and Index target specification (paths, dirs, exclude, all) as a complete desired state
Pattern matching rules where ** matches zero or more directory levels
Fixed exclusions, symbolic link handling, and departure from the Index target
Independence of document IDs from ToC keys; one document can belong to multiple keys
Writing doc_link_id into frontmatter, including blank line rule when creating frontmatter
Fixing the Index target list before any ID issuance or change detection
DLID issuance format: DLID- prefix plus 12 Crockford Base32 characters from 60-bit random value
Validation of missing or unrecognizable IDs, duplicate detection, and original selection by the user
DLID resolution to current paths with recorded content hash, without modifying documents or ToC
Document ID confirmation stage, DLID assignment operation, and acceptance conditions AC-005 to AC-031
tasks: Designing or implementing DLID assignment (check and issue) operations
Implementing directory pattern matching and fixed exclusion logic
Implementing DLID resolution to current paths
Handling duplicate DLIDs and reissuing IDs for copied documents
Writing doc_link_id and section IDs into document frontmatter and headings
Implementing the document ID confirmation stage of ToC build
Reviewing integration with Forge callers passing ToC keys
Writing tests for the acceptance conditions of document ID handling
